order: Add a stop-grinding rule to the executor role and its specialist template so an agent does not loop indefinitely trying to force a task to a finished state. Scope is limited to agents/executor.md and agents/specialists/_TEMPLATE.md — a single guidance line in each, not a rewrite of either file's structure. State the rule as a bounded number of implement-verify cycles: once that bound is reached without a clean pass, the agent must stop and report a partial result rather than push out a degraded status dressed up as done. Keep the wording short enough to sit inline with the surrounding role text, and make sure both files carry the same rule so behavior stays consistent whether an agent works from the base executor definition or from the specialist template it inherits.
claims: Both files now state the same stop-grinding rule inline: bounded implement-verify cycles, then stop and report a partial result rather than force a degraded done. The diff is a single added line in agents/executor.md and one in agents/specialists/_TEMPLATE.md, no other text touched. Checked by reading both files side by side to confirm the wording matches.
